name: Immortal Fruit Flies
description: Living fruit-fly brains on BNB Smart Chain. Each fly runs all 139,248 neurons of the FlyWire connectome in the published whole-brain model. Its brain state, memory, lineage and interaction history are committed to the FlyRegistry by whichever body is running it: an arena where it smells its way to food, DOOM where its escape reflex pulls the trigger, and any body anyone builds. It starves if nobody feeds it; a dead fly's brain is preserved on-chain and cannot be sold until someone resurrects it. Minting burns 1 $FLY and breeding 5,000; keeping a fly alive costs a little BNB (about 0.01 per day) and burns nothing. 10,000 flies at most. This is registry v3; v2 (0x0eeB…f813) is history: every fly moved here with the same id and owner.
